detailed_description:
Cinematic semi-realistic 3D rendering with soft volumetric skin shading, fine floating hair strands, woven fabric texture and natural folds in Ava’s taupe clothing. The characters, shark and wreckage share the same underwater particulate matter, cold surface light, caustic shimmer and contact shadows, without reproducing any reference-sheet panels or studio backgrounds.

[Shot 1] The shot begins underwater in a medium half-low-angle composition, looking upward through churning gray-blue water from <Subject 2>. The listing rusted ocean liner, red-and-black funnels, broken masts, hanging cables and jagged floating debris are distorted beyond the surface, while pale storm light breaks through in cold uneven rays. <Subject 1> is suspended diagonally in the center, her long straight black hair fanning upward, her light taupe sleeveless top and matching belted trousers pulled by the water, and her pale sneakers trailing below. Her torso is locked tight, her mouth is open, and both hands slap toward the shimmering surface without reaching it. Rising beneath her, <Subject 4> fills the lower frame with scarred slate-blue skin, a pale underside, black eyes, gill slits and broad fins. The shark deliberately closes its jaws around Ava’s lower leg; the contact is readable between its rows of triangular teeth and her trouser leg, and her body jerks upward from the force. Bubbles burst from her open mouth. A small cloud of desaturated dark green spreads through the natural gray-blue water beside the bite, while the wound remains covered by the shark’s jaws and moving fabric, with no open injury shown. The camera gives a short violent shake at impact, then stops abruptly. Synchronized sound includes a heavy wet bite, Ava’s muffled scream, turbulent water rushing around her body, and one dull heartbeat, “thump.”

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close facial shot of <Subject 1>, centered among drifting hair, bubbles and dark water. Her dark brown eyes are beginning to lose focus, her brow is tight with pain, and her lips tremble as she forces her gaze forward. A hologram blooms directly in front of her using the visual design of <Subject 3>: a deep underwater-blue field, cyan particles, thin glowing borders and translucent rounded cards like those on the phone screen. The countdown window displays “3,” then snaps to “2,” then “1” in clean illuminated numerals. Behind the panel, the dark shape of <Subject 4> remains attached to her leg; its black eye, pale jaw and rows of teeth are partly visible through the murk, and the liner-wreck surface remains a blurred storm-dark band above. The camera slowly pushes toward Ava’s face, keeping the hologram aligned between her eyes and the viewer while the edges of the water darken. Sharp electronic ticks accompany each numeral, the low heartbeat continues, and the underwater rumble is gradually pressed downward. A calm female phone-system voice (S1), with no visible speaking body in the scene, says in an electronic off-screen interface voice, in American English with lip sync applied only to the interface’s subtle voice waveform, <d>[English] Rebirth countdown: three, two, one.</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to a static near shot showing <Subject 1> from a slight side-front angle, with her trembling hand in the foreground and the holographic option panel beyond it. Her wet black hair drifts around her shoulders, small bubbles escape from her lips, and her pained eyes remain fixed on the interface derived from <Subject 3>. A rounded cyan-blue option card is visibly labeled “重生”. Ava lifts her shaking arm against the water and places her fingertip directly on the glowing option. The system answers with a clear confirmation chime. At the touch, cyan-white light erupts from the center of the pop-up in a flat, rapidly expanding field. It races past Ava’s face and hand, illuminates the surrounding wreck-filled water from <Subject 2>, and swallows the open jaws, teeth and black eye of <Subject 4> until the shark disappears into the radiance. The camera stays static through the touch, gives one brief sharp shake as the interface bursts outward, then holds on Ava’s lit face and outstretched hand. <Subject 1> (S2), breathless and strained, says in American English with lip movements synced to the words, <d>[English] I choose rebirth.</d> Her gasping bubbles continue around the words, followed by the system confirmation tone and a huge electronic hum that expands with the light.

The clip is wrapped in muffled underwater pressure, distant storm surf, drifting bubbles and the heavy movement of the shark through the sea. Its synchronized physical layer includes the wet bite impact, turbulent water, Ava’s scream and gasping, a dull heartbeat, electronic countdown ticks, a confirmation chime and a surging interface hum. No ambient sound suggests that she has escaped before the final rebirth activation.
